name: Benchmark Lab v1
purpose: Define reproducible mobile benchmark fixtures, modes, adapters, and claim boundaries for ZMR against framework-relevant local runners.

claimPolicy.forbiddenClaim: Do not present fixture results as universal speed or reliability claims.

modes.label: Cold command
modes.description: Each row measures the command surface a user would run from a shell, including runner startup.

modes.label: Warm suite
modes.description: The app, device, and runner bridge are prepared before timed rows so the benchmark isolates repeated scenario execution.

modes.label: Native floor
modes.description: A lower-bound timing for the platform shim path. It is diagnostic evidence, not a product comparison.

fixtures.label: React Native and Expo workflow
fixtures.notes: Use testID, accessibility labels, Expo dev-client deep links, and a committed generated fixture before collecting public rows.

fixtures.label: Flutter semantics workflow
fixtures.notes: Measure app-level Android/iOS automation through semantics labels and deep links. Do not claim widget-tree driver support.

runnerAdapters.label: Appium
runnerAdapters.notes: The current public iOS workflow attempt failed while starting WebDriverAgent, so fixture-specific setup hardening is required before timing rows.

runnerAdapters.label: Detox
runnerAdapters.notes: Requires a React Native fixture with project-local native build targets and a test harness.

nextSlices.description: Collect 20-run Android rows for the generated native workflow on a clean emulator.
Add a generated React Native/Expo fixture with stable test IDs, deep links, and matching ZMR and baseline flows.
Add a Flutter fixture that proves app-level semantics support without widget-tree claims.
Add suite-level benchmark collection so bridge prewarm and repeated scenario execution are measured separately from cold command startup.
